formal_statement: ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ l : ℕ, ∀ π : List (PEqualNP.Search.CPLine (Fin (2 ^ l + 1) × Fin l)), PEqualNP.Search.IsCPRefutation (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.BPHP (2 ^ l + 1) l) π → p.eval (2 ^ l) < π.length
plain_statement: For every polynomial p there is l such that every cutting planes refutation over the integers of bit PHP with 2^l+1 pigeons and 2^l holes has more than p(2^l) lines. Known result formalized: Beame and Whitmeyer, ICALP 2025, Theorem 1.5. From the two lemmas before it. Turns the kill of candidate 4 (stabbing planes, via simulation by CP) from a citation into a checked lemma for its CP part.
title: Cutting planes refutations of bit pigeonhole are superpolynomial in lines
